key_insight: AI is emerging as a practical framework to understand, predict, and mitigate instability in 3D all-inorganic CsPbX3 perovskites by linking diagnosis, mechanism discovery, reliability modeling, and stability engineering.
engineering_relevance: The review highlights how AI can accelerate the design of more durable perovskite optoelectronic devices by guiding material selection, degradation control, and reliability-aware optimization.
method: Consequence/reliability modeling and engineering stability enhancement
evidence_signal: The abstract emphasizes that AI is useful because conventional approaches struggle with multimodal data, coupled degradation pathways, protocol dependence, sparse statistics, and uncertainty quantification.
watch_item: Current AI studies are limited by inconsistent data quality and protocols, weak benchmarks, and poor transferability across domains.
paper_title: Artificial Intelligence for Instability in Inorganic Perovskites: From Mechanism Discovery to Engineering Strategies
